function.name: get_website_geo_mapping_rules

websiteId.description: The unique identifier of the website for which the geo mapping rules are to be retrieved. The identifier should be in UUID format.

function.name: set_website_geo_mapping_rules
function.description: This function sets custom geographic mapping rules for a specific website by using its unique website identifier. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

mobileAppId.description: The unique identifier of the mobile application for which the geo mapping rules are to be fetched.
